Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra Announce Second Pregnancy

Actors Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra have announced they are expecting their second child. Advani shared a post on Instagram featuring their daughter Saraayah holding a small white sock, with the caption "Blessed once again with the greatest gift of all." The couple, who met while filming Shershaah, married in Jaisalmer in February 2023 and welcomed their first child, Saraayah, approximately a year ago.
